title: HIMX: mixed-format matrix multiplication based on customized HIFLOAT4 representations
abstract: arXiv:2611.18641v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: 4-bit weight-activation quantization (W4A4) is an important approach for efficient large language model (LLM) inference. Recent hierarchical formats such as HiFloat4 (HIF4) improve the representational range of 4-bit quantization through multi-level scaling. However, the same local mantissa representation in HIF4 may not be equally suitable for weights and activations, which exhibit distinct distribution characteristics. To address this limitation, we propose HiMX, a mixed-mantissa framework built upon the hierarchical scaling structure of HIF4. Our key observation is that the two HIF4-compatible mantissa representations, S1P2 and E2M1, exhibit complementary quantization behavior: the denser S1P2 format provides higher resolution for concentrated weight distributions, while the wider-spaced E2M1 format provides complementary quantization characteristics for activation tensors. translated_title: HIMX：基于定制化HIFLOAT4表示的混合格式矩阵乘法
translated_abstract: 4位权重-激活量化（W4A4）是实现高效大语言模型（LLM）推理的重要方法。近期出现的分层格式（如HiFloat4，HIF4）通过多级缩放提升了4位量化的表示范围。然而，HIF4中相同的局部尾数表示可能并不同等适用于权重和激活值，因为二者呈现出截然不同的分布特性。为解决这一局限，我们提出了HiMX，一个建立在HIF4分层缩放结构之上的混合尾数框架。我们的关键观察是：两种与HIF4兼容的尾数表示——S1P2和E2M1——展现出互补的量化行为，其中更密集的S1P2格式能够为集中的权重分布提供更高的分辨率，而间距更宽的E2M1格式则为激活张量提供互补的量化特性。HiMX支持针对不同操作数定制的尾数表示……
tldr: 提出HiMX混合尾数框架，根据权重与激活值的分布差异，分别为其定制互补的HIF4兼容尾数表示（更密集的S1P2用于权重、间距更宽的E2M1用于激活），从而改进4位量化的LLM高效推理。
en_tdlr: HiMX is a mixed-mantissa framework built on HIF4's hierarchical scaling that tailors complementary mantissa representations—denser S1P2 for weights and wider-spaced E2M1 for activations—to their distinct distributions, improving W4A4 quantization for efficient LLM inference.
